content.rendered:
THANK YOU to our amazing volunteers! Whether you are a PAC Board Member, you attend PAC meetings, you support in the classroom/on field trips, you deliver popcorn on Fridays, you teach Art Literacy, you beautify our bulletin boards, or you volunteer time in a variety of other ways; we couldn’t do it without you! We are so grateful to all of our amazing volunteers and the gift of your time & talents. You are appreciated! We hope you were able to enjoy some treats in the office this week!

Please find this weeks Update here.
